notes.zh-CN:
## 4.3.24 更新日志

- 集中显示原生 Streamline 插件版本，并单独标注保留的游戏 interposer；区分原生帧生成与 Encore 可选的额外引擎。
- 保持原有完整卸载行为，清理补丁设置和专属日志；各方案卸载后移除管理器空缓存目录，兼顾旧版残留，保留未知文件与原件备份。
- 修复小窗口中运行库条目被压缩的问题，新增控件跟随软件字号。

已知上游限制：Encore 2.0.1 的额外 DLSS-FG 引擎仍可能显示缺件提示，即使游戏原生帧生成正常。不会为隐藏提示而覆盖原生 interposer；详情见 [上游 issue #112](https://github.com/SilyNoMeta/rtx-encore/issues/112)。
notes.en:
## 4.3.24 Release notes

- Show native Streamline plugin versions separately from the preserved game interposer. Clarify the distinction between native frame generation and Encore's optional added engine.
- Keep the original full uninstall behavior: remove patch settings and owned logs. Clean empty manager cache folders for all patch schemes, including leftovers from older releases, while preserving unknown files and backups.
- Keep runtime rows readable in smaller windows and scale the new controls with the application's font setting.

Known upstream limitation: Encore 2.0.1 may still show an additional DLSS-FG engine dependency warning while native frame generation works. The native interposer is not overwritten to hide it; see [upstream issue #112](https://github.com/SilyNoMeta/rtx-encore/issues/112).
